guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice shows the largest anomalies: latency-50 rose 2017% (z=+403) and memory rose 349% (4.49e7 to 2.02e8, z=+69.8), and the worst traces all pass through currencyservice, with frontend and checkout latency elevated as downstream effects. Memory growth is the strongest resource signal on that service, while CPU moved only modestly (+30%) and socket count rose (3 to 6) in a way that fits a symptom of slow requests; logs contain no errors, so the fault type is inferred from metrics alone.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to release memory, then inspect for a memory leak or unbounded cache and set memory limits and alerts. Non-destructive, since the service is stateless.
